name: Two Wire Electric Supply Co
old_description: Family owned since 1975, we are a wholesale electrical supply distributor committed to providing the best products and customer service in the area.  We are a full line ABB (formerly GE) distributor of power distribution equipment. From light bulbs to switch gear we offer a wide range of products for the industrial, commercial, and residential contractor.
about:
Two Wire Electric Supply Co. has operated as a family-owned wholesale electrical distributor in Jackson, Mississippi, since 1975. The company was established to serve the region's electrical supply needs and remains under family ownership, providing a consistent local presence for contractors and businesses.

As a full-line distributor for ABB (formerly General Electric) power distribution equipment, the company stocks products ranging from light bulbs to switchgear. Its inventory covers a broad spectrum of electrical materials for construction, maintenance, and repair projects, including circuit breakers, panel boards, lighting fixtures, and wiring devices.

The distributor serves industrial, commercial, and residential contractors across the Jackson area. Customers include electrical contractors working on commercial buildings, industrial facilities, and residential wiring projects, as well as maintenance departments and facility managers.

The company emphasizes product availability and customer service as its primary differentiators, aiming to be a reliable local source for electrical supplies. Operating Monday through Friday from 6:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST, the business maintains hours aligned with contractor schedules.
